memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Mild intermittent asthma with occupational exposure.
Patient reports occasional wheezing after long drives, no night symptoms. Uses salbutamol inhaler 2-3 times per week. No smoking, never smoker. Exam: mild expiratory wheeze bilaterally, normal spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% pred), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; change from prior +0.1 L. ACT score 20 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Comorbidities: rheumatoid arthritis on methotrexate, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine, low-dose prednisolone; vitamin B12 deficiency on methylcobalamin.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs PRN every 4-6 hours for wheeze.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 12.8 g/L (13.0-17.5), MCV 98 fL (80-100), Serum vitamin B12 150 pg/mL (200-900) low. ESR 28 mm/hr (0-20) elevated. CRP 12 mg/L (<5) elevated. Rheumatoid factor 45 IU/ml (<14) positive. Anti-CCP 32 U/ml (<7) positive. Liver function: ALT 22 U/L (7-56), AST 20 U/L (10-40), ALP 78 U/L (40-129), GGT 30 U/L (0-51), bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL (0.2-1.2).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Stable asthma, improving B12.
Patient uses inhaler <2 times/week, no nocturnal symptoms. Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% pred), FVC 3.3 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L since last. ACT 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. B12 deficiency symptomatic improvement; methylcobalamin started. RA symptoms mild, no joint swelling noted. Smoking status never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.
Methotrexate 10 mg once weekly continued.
Folic acid 5 mg once weekly continued.
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD continued.
Prednisolone 5 mg OD continued.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 13.5 g/L (13.0-17.5), MCV 89 fL (80-100), Serum vitamin B12 420 pg/mL (200-900) normal. ESR 14 mm/hr (0-20) normal. CRP 4 mg/L (<5) normal. RF 12 IU/ml (<14) borderline. Anti-CCP 5 U/ml (<7) normal. LFT: ALT 18, AST 16, ALP 70, GGT 22, bilirubin 0.7 all within normal limits.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Well-controlled asthma, RA stable.
No wheeze, rescue inhaler use 0-1 times/week. Spirometry: FEV1 3.0 L (98% pred), FVC 3.4 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L. ACT 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Inspiratory flow adequate for DPI if used. RA: no active synovitis, methotrexate tolerated. B12 replete. Smoking never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Continue salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs PRN.
Continue methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD.
Continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: "Doctor, my wrists and knees have been aching more lately, especially after work. I feel stiff in the mornings. Should I increase my RA meds?"

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Rheumatology for evaluation of worsening rheumatoid arthritis symptoms despite current DMARD regimen. Request assessment of disease activity and possible therapy escalation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatology review: Disease activity moderate (DAS28 3.8). Advised to increase methotrexate to 15 mg weekly, continue folic acid, consider adding low-dose prednisolone taper if needed. Patient educated on side effects. Follow-up in 8 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 13.4 g/L, MCV 90 fL, Serum vitamin B12 460 pg/mL. ESR 10 mm/hr, CRP 3 mg/L. RF 10 IU/ml, Anti-CCP 4 U/ml. LFT: ALT 20, AST 18, ALP 68, GGT 20, bilirubin 0.6.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Post-rheumatology advice: methotrexate increased.
Asthma: no symptoms, inhaler use 0 times/week. Spirometry: FEV1 3.1 L (101% pred), FVC 3.5 L, FEV1/FVC 0.89; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L. ACT 25 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. RA: methotrexate increased to 15 mg weekly per rheumatology, folic acid unchanged. Joint aches improved, morning stiffness <30 min. B12 normal. Smoking never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Methotrexate 15 mg once weekly.
Folic acid 5 mg once weekly.
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD.
Prednisolone 5 mg OD (continue).
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs PRN.
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow‑up pulmonology review for 2026-04-15 at 10:30 am with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma well controlled, RA stable.
No wheeze, rescue inhaler nil. Spirometry: FEV1 3.2 L (104% pred), FVC 3.6 L, FEV1/FVC 0.89; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L since last visit. ACT 25 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. RA: methotrexate 15 mg weekly tolerated, no active synovitis, mild morning stiffness <15 min. B12 replete. Smoking never. Plan: continue current meds, next review in 4 months.
